known_limitations: The complete custom battle interface was tested in the browser, but Godot is presently an engine smoke fixture rather than the implementation host for that UI.
The separate Godot Web export is an approximately 49 MB engine/runtime build and does not contain the custom HTML battler UI; use the custom-runtime web ZIP for the playable slice.
Playtest observation and browser UI interaction are agent-run, not human playtest or human art approval.

The atlas inspection in the browser exhibited black/transparent-looking regions on the Tempest Wyrm artwork; individual creature sprite assets are used for the playable arena. Human visual/art review remains open.
human_gates: Review image generation provenance and license register before any public/commercial distribution.
Play the packaged ZIP from a clean local copy and review appearance at target browser/device sizes.
Review balance/fairness beyond the deterministic foil-vs-standard automated proof.
